title: Tech Note: 4D REST API: Connecting 4D with Angular

historical_commentary.text: The general approach (4D REST API as backend for an Angular SPA) is still valid and is 4D's standard modern web-integration pattern, though the full technical detail (specific Angular version, HttpClient code, exact REST endpoint configuration) cannot be verified since only the published abstract is available.
related_updates: 4D REST (built on ORDA) remains 4D's standard mechanism for serving data to any modern SPA framework (Angular, React, Vue); this is still the recommended architecture today.
SOAP-based web services are legacy by comparison; REST + ORDA, as demonstrated here, is the modern standard 4D promotes for exactly this kind of frontend integration.
